children.text: Cervical radiculopathy is characterized by unilateral arm pain, numbness and tingling in a dermatomal distribution in the upper extremity, and weakness in specific muscle groups
Evaluation consists of a thorough neurologic examination, cervical spine radiographs (including flexion-extension views), and MRI of the cervical spine
